rationale: The only exception was unit-of-measure: the supplier billed 480 EACH @ $2.00 against a PO of 40 CASE @ $24.00, and at the pack size of 12 in vendor.json these are identical ($960.00 net). Clause 2 makes that a routine normalisation, not a defect. Receipt GR-7702 confirms 40 CASE received (clause 1 three-way match satisfied), price variance is $0.00 (clause 3), and recomputed tax at 7.5% is exactly $72.00 (clause 5). No credit memos; net payable $1,032.00 falls in the AP_CLERK band (clause 10).
